title: NEU Link
summary: The primary smart campus gateway for Near East University: native iOS and Android apps, a Next.js web app and admin dashboard, all on NestJS backends I build, deploy and run.
overview: I own the whole NEU Link ecosystem end to end: the React Native apps on iOS and Android, the Next.js web app at link.neu.edu.tr, the Next.js admin dashboard, and the NestJS services behind them. I also run production myself on a VPS with Nginx as reverse proxy, PM2 for process management and Cloudflare for DNS and performance.

highlights.title: Live transit & QR boarding
highlights.text: Real-time bus tracking with live locations and ETAs to each stop, plus in-app QR codes for fast boarding.

highlights.title: Secure event attendance
highlights.text: Attendance for students and staff verified in layers: geolocation, automatic BLE hardware detection and dynamic or static QR scanning, because events feed into personnel earnings and performance points.

highlights.title: Capacity-aware campus maps
highlights.text: Dual-platform maps (Apple Maps / Mapbox) with campus-wide routing, building directions and live capacity for gathering spaces.

highlights.title: Bookings on the lock screen
highlights.text: Facility reservations with iOS Live Activities counting down each slot on the lock screen, and equivalent notifications on Android.

highlights.title: 1-to-1 web parity
highlights.text: A full Next.js web version of the platform with the same features as the mobile apps.

highlights.title: Run in production
highlights.text: Deployment and operations on a VPS with Nginx, PM2 and Cloudflare, owned from database to App Store release.

title: Punica HR
summary: An enterprise HR platform with accessible, multilingual dashboards for people, tasks, partners, inventory and documents, built around secure API integrations and fast data visualisation.
overview: Punica brings HR and operations into one platform: the People module for HR management, Tasks for project and task tracking, plus Partners, Inventory and Documents. I built accessible, multilingual dashboards on top of secure API integrations, with widget-based home screens and data visualisation for organisational management.

highlights.title: Widget dashboards
highlights.text: Configurable home screens with attendance clock-in, time requests, announcements, tasks, weekly hours and statistics widgets.

highlights.title: Accessible by default
highlights.text: Dashboards built with accessibility in mind, following WCAG 2.2 and ARIA practices.

highlights.title: Multilingual
highlights.text: English and Turkish throughout the product and marketing site.

highlights.title: Secure integrations
highlights.text: Frontend built around secure API integrations and high-performance data visualisation.

title: NEU Smart Switch
summary: A hardware-software system that switches sports facility lighting on and off from bookings, keeps working when the backend is down, and heals itself after a power cut.
overview: An independent IoT system with its own dashboard and user management (roles and permissions) that schedules and controls lighting in the university's sports facilities based on new bookings. The server runs on the same subnet as the Shelly switches so it can talk to each one directly over a dedicated static IP.

highlights.title: Booking-driven lighting
highlights.text: New facility bookings automatically schedule the lights for that slot, managed from a dashboard with roles and permissions.

highlights.title: Survives backend outages
highlights.text: A steady cron payload from the NEU server is persisted locally, so the switches keep their schedule even when the backend is unreachable.

highlights.title: Self-healing after power cuts
highlights.text: A custom reboot script in the Shelly firmware pings the Smart Switch server when power returns, then validates and restores the correct state immediately.

highlights.title: Direct device networking
highlights.text: The VPS shares a subnet with the switches, reaching each device on its own static IP.
